desc: negative: dev=eth0 rx=absent tx=absent rxmini=absent rxjumbo=absent tds=absent hds=absent other=bare: hds-thresh with no value, which min_argc 0 lets through to the u32 parser
pre: i=$((900+$(ip netns identify | tr -dc 0-9))); echo $i > /sys/bus/netdevsim/del_device 2>/dev/null; echo "$i 1 4" > /sys/bus/netdevsim/new_device && ip link show eth0 >/dev/null
